# STEP 3 — ORDER (asli brain)

Jab rules aapas me takrayein to kaun jeetega — is file me har faisla likha hai.
Step 4 ka engine inhi faislon par chalega. Faisle user ke design par tikke hain:
**Kahani > Samajh aana > Rhythm > Style/Effect.**

> ⚠️ ExpoCut attribution: Free to use and redistribute with attribution to expocut.com
> (kuch defaults me ExpoCut playbook ke numbers ek paksh the.)

---

## 1. Order — chaar seedhiyan

| Seedhi | Layer | Matlab | Haar kab hoti hai |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (sabse upar) | **Kahani** | Vaada, open loops, payoff, stakes, kahani aage badh rahi hai ya nahi | Kabhi nahi — sirf insaan ka veto isse upar hai |
| 2 | **Samajh aana** | Baat saaf samajh aaye: captions padhne layak, B-roll wahi jo bola, awaaz saaf, cut aankh ko dhakka na de | Sirf Kahani se |
| 3 | **Rhythm** | Cadence, pacing, gaps, WPM, timing ke numbers | Kahani aur Samajh se |
| 4 (sabse neeche) | **Style/Effect** | Punch-in, SFX, colour, sajawat, cool effects | Teeno se — effect kitna bhi cool ho, baat samajh na aaye to effect hatega (user ki apni misaal) |

## 2. Faisle ke meta-niyam (takraav suljhane ka tarika)

1. **Layer pehle:** alag-alag layer ke rules takrayein to upar wali seedhi jeetegi. (Relevance gate Samajh ka hai, B-roll cadence Rhythm ki — gate jeetega, hamesha.)
2. **Ek hi layer me evidence:** 🟢 research > 🟡 measured > 🟠 opinion. Naapa hua sach raay se upar.
3. **Phir bhi barabar ho to profile faisla karega:** format (long-form / Shorts), platform (YouTube / Reels / TikTok / podcast), content type (explainer / entertainment / talking-head). Har profile ke defaults Section 4 me hain.
4. **Kam hastakshep jeete (Murch ki qurbani):** sab barabar ho to jo faisla video me kam badlav kare — kam cut, kam effect — wo jeetega. Badlav hamesha neeche wali seedhi se katega, upar wali se nahi.
5. **Insaan ka veto sabse upar:** engine kabhi aakhiri faisla nahi hai. Emotion aur sundarta par engine sirf FLAG lagayega; faisla insaan ka. (Section 3.)

## 3. KENDRIYA FAISLA — Emotion kahan baithega (Conflict #20)

**Faisla: Emotion engine ke BAHAR rahega — insaan ki aankh par. Engine use naapega nahi, sirf flag karega.**

Kyun: Murch Emotion ko 51% deta hai — sabse bada hissa. Lekin jo cheez sabse badi hai wahi sabse kam naapne layak hai. User ki ghoshit seema bhi yahi hai: "rules ye nahi bata sakte ki photo sundar hai ya emotion sahi hai." To Murch ka samman is roop me hoga:
- Engine ke andar sabse upar **Kahani** hai (Murch ka Story 23% + uske naapne-layak hisse).
- Emotion se jude beats (payoff, sabse bhaari line, dramatic pause, chehre wale pal) engine **pehchan ke flag** karega: "ye pal insaan dekhe."
- Insaan ka veto engine ke har faisle se upar hai — engine PASS de de tab bhi insaan emotion par rok sakta hai.

Matlab: Murch ki seedhi engine ke andar is roop me chalegi —
**[Insaan: Emotion] > Kahani > Samajh (eye-trace yahin aata hai) > Rhythm > 2-D/3-D/Style.**

## 4. Saare takraavon ke faisle (CONFLICTS.md ke 24 vishay)

**#1 Pattern-interrupt cadence** → FAISLA: interrupt ghadi se nahi, **jagah** se lagega — event/section boundary par (Zacks 🟢 + re-hook rule). Default hadd: long-form explainer me kam se kam har **120 s** me ek deliberate re-hook/interrupt hona chahiye; entertainment long-form me **60 s**; Shorts is rule se bahar (wahan cadence #2 chalega). CraigHewitt ka 15–30 s wala timer default NAHI banega — 🟡 measured (slopstudio: flat pacing, ~1/act) aur 🟢 (Smith ki ceiling) usse upar hain. PROFILE SWITCH: pure entertainment channel chahe to 30–60 s band on kar sakta hai.

**#2 Visual-change cadence** → FAISLA: max static gap ka ek number — **5 s** (teeno bade paksh 2–4 / 3–5 / 3–7 isi par milte hain; 🟡 slopstudio bhi 5 s se upar bharosa nahi karta). Shorts profile: **3 s**. Hook ke pehle 5 s: **3 s**. Cold open (long-form): measured band hi chalega — pehle 30 s me 2–7 cuts (🟡), tez cadence wahan nahi ghusayenge.

**#3 Cutting-speed ceiling** → FAISLA: Smith ki ceiling (🟢, Samajh) **hard limit** hai — koi cadence rule (Rhythm) isse tez nahi ja sakta. Engine cadence ki har demand ko ceiling se takra ke trim karega.

**#4 Mid-event flow vs interrupt** → FAISLA: interrupt **sirf event boundary par** (Zacks 🟢). Beech-event cut tabhi jab wo Kahani ki deliberate chaal ho — engine use flag karega, khud nahi lagayega.

**#5 Punch-in** → FAISLA: default **sirf motivated** (wajah ke saath), hadd ≤10/min aur do punch-in ke beech ≥4 s. Cadence-wala punch-in (har 2nd/3rd cut) sirf **entertainment Shorts profile** me on hoga. Punch-in Style hai — Samajh/Rhythm se takraye to hamesha harega.

**#6 Pause/silence — ek final model** → FAISLA (teenon model jod ke ek table):
- *Threshold (kab kato):* silence **≥400 ms** = cut zone · 150–400 ms = usable (rehne do ya trim) · <150 ms = haath mat lagao.
- *Kitna bachao:* kata hua pause **0.2–0.45 s** ka remainder rakhe (blazerior 0.2–0.3 aur Jake 0.45 isi band ke do kinare hain).
- *Edge:* har cut ke edge par **30–200 ms** padding (ye pause nahi, edge suraksha hai).
- *Speaker badle:* **400–600 ms** hawa.
- *Style apvaad:* super-fast style profile (Melvynx 30–80 ms gaps) sirf tab jab poori video usi style me ho — aadha-aadha nahi.

**#7 Dead air vs dramatic pause** → FAISLA: bina-wajah ki khamoshi **>1 s = kategi** (koi takraav nahi). Dramatic pause (1–2 s) sirf tab bachega jab uske saath visual/chehra use utha raha ho; engine pehchan na paye to **human flag** — khud faisla nahi.

**#8 B-roll cadence vs relevance** → FAISLA: **relevance gate hamesha jeetega** (Samajh > Rhythm). Cadence due hone par bhi sajawati B-roll nahi aayega — uski jagah punch-in/graphic/layout badlav se cadence puri hogi. Cadence numbers format se: long talking-head 30–60 s · paper-stage shorts 8–15 s · marketing 5–10 s · talking-reel punches ≤10/min.

**#9 Sponsor ki jagah** → FAISLA: **pehla payoff pehle** (Kahani) — sponsor uske baad hi. Uske baad 20–33% wala container (🟡) sirf tab lagu jab payoff usse pehle aa gaya ho; warna container payoff ke baad khisak jayega.

**#10 Escalation vs flat pacing** → FAISLA: **dono jeette hain** — lever alag hain. Stakes/intensity ki escalation (Kahani) badegi; cut/WPM ki speed FLAT (🟡) rahegi. Engine dono ko alag-alag naapega, ek dusre se takrane nahi dega.

**#11 Music level** → FAISLA: ek bhasha — **voice ke neeche relative dB**. Default band: **18–25 dB under voice**, bolte waqt ducking aur 6–12 dB. ~12 dB wala naapa apvaad (🟡) sirf **style-copy profile** me chalega, jahan pehle original ko naapa gaya ho.

**#12 Master loudness** → FAISLA: **−14 LUFS / ≤−1 dBTP** default (YouTube/social, 🟡). **Podcast profile: −16 LKFS.** mktkit ka −16 wala house master ek **alag render profile** ke roop me rahega, default nahi — ek pipeline, ek target.

**#13 Captions** → FAISLA: format se batega — **vertical: 32 chars/line**, **16:9: 42 chars/line**, reading speed ≤20 CPS (bachchon ka content 17). Mode: Shorts me word-chunks **1–3 shabd** jalte hue; long-form me phrase captions + keyword pops (poore jalte captions nahi). Ek channel = ek style, consistency Samajh ka hissa hai.

**#14 Safe zones** → FAISLA: ek master table — har platform ke liye teeno sources ke numbers ka **sakht intersection** (jo hissa teeno me surakshit, wahi final). Engine platform profile se wahi table uthayega.

**#15 Thumbnail text** → FAISLA: **target ≤3 shabd, hard cap 4**. (MrBeast profile ka 0–2 ideal ke roop me note rahega; 5 wali sabse dheeli hadd reject.)

**#16 Title caps** → FAISLA: sakht wala jeetega — **zyada se zyada 1 shabd CAPS** (emphasis ke liye); full-caps title banned. (Samajh/imaandari: chillata title vaade ko sasta karta hai.)

**#17 Hook ki lambai/window** → FAISLA: Shorts spoken hook **<12 shabd** (sakht). Long-form hook **9–24 shabd**, core pehle **15 s** me, puri hook-beat **30 s** ke andar — dono numbers apni jagah (core vs structure), takraav nahi.

**#18 Short-form duration** → FAISLA: platform profile se — Shorts **15–30 s** (self-contained moment 20–55 s) · Reels **15–30 s** · TikTok **15–45 s** · educational short **60–90 s**. Lambai idea tay karega, platform ki max nahi.

**#19 WPM** → FAISLA: dono chalenge, kaam alag — script ki **planning 150 WPM** par; asal narration delivery ka target band **160–195 WPM** (🟡 measured). Tutorial/demo profile me band neeche khisak sakta hai (type-wise gati).

**#20 Emotion** → Section 3 ka faisla (engine ke bahar, insaan ka veto, engine sirf flag).

**#21 Filler vs texture** → FAISLA: jo cue **sirf filler** hai wo katega; lekin jumle ke andar ki natural texture (saans, hasi, aadha jumla) **bachegi** — Samajh saaf ho aur Kahani ka bharosa bana rahe. Line: filler *shabd* katega, bolne wala *insaan* nahi.

**#22 Load-bearing turns ke %** → FAISLA: percentages **sirf long-form** par lagu (payoff 55–85% band wahi se aaya hai). Short/mid-form par percentages nahi, **seconds** chalenge (payoff Shorts me 15–25 s ke aas-paas). Engine format dekh ke scale badlega.

**#23 Title formulas** → FAISLA: formulas **library** hain, rule nahi. Engine sirf checklist check karega (lambai ≤100, front-load, caps hadd, vaada sachha). Kaunsa formula kis niche me chalega — ye faisla corpus ke bina engine nahi lega; niche-validity note rule ke saath rahega.

**#24 Hook repeat** → FAISLA: default **OFF**. Sirf **talking-reel / loop-Shorts profile** me ON (mktkit ka design wahi ke liye tha). Long-form me repeat = galti hi rahegi.

## 5. Profiles (engine ke liye defaults ka khulasa)

| Profile | Max visual gap | Interrupt hadd | Captions | Loudness | Khaas |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| long_explainer | 5 s (cold open 2–7 cuts/30 s) | ≥1 re-hook / 120 s, sirf boundary par | 42 chars, phrase + pops | −14 LUFS | Flat pacing, stakes escalation |
| long_entertainment | 5 s | ≥1 / 60 s | 42 chars | −14 LUFS | Punch-in motivated; 30–60 s interrupt band optional |
| shorts | 3 s | — (cadence hi sab hai) | 32 chars, 1–3 shabd chunks | −14 LUFS | Hook <12 shabd, duration 15–30 s |
| talking_reel | 3–7 s (punches ≤10/min) | hook repeat ON (sirf yahan) | 32 chars × 2 | −16 LUFS house profile uplabdh | B-roll exactness sakht |
| podcast | — (audio pehle) | — | 42 chars | −16 LKFS | Speaker handoff 400–600 ms |

## 6. Engine ke liye nirdesh (Step 4)

- Engine rules.json + is ORDER ko padhega: pehle profile ke defaults, phir layer ki seedhi, phir evidence, phir kam-hastakshep.
- Jo rule machine se naapa nahi ja sakta (178 rules), engine unhe "insaan ki nazar" list me rakhega — khaaskar emotion/payoff/dramatic-pause wale beats par flag ke saath.
- Har takraav ke faisle par engine report me likhega: kaunsa rule jeeta, kaunsa hara, aur kis meta-niyam se. Faisla chhupana nahi hai.
